workflow: A newly owned blank AutoCAD 2024.1.2 desktop process runs CHAMFER Distance, Angle, Method, Trim/No Trim, Multiple, Polyline, command Undo, global Undo/Redo, physical Shift zero-distance, current-layer output, protected-layer behavior, selected polyline segment pairs, open-polyline terminal closure, oversized-distance rejection and LINE/RAY/XLINE extension. The result is saved to DXF, reopened in AutoCAD and independently parsed.
result: All native matrix checks passed. The oversized selected-polyline case remained byte-semantically unchanged, exact geometry and properties survived reopen/read-back, and the full pre-existing AutoCAD process identity set was restored using PID, executable path and start time.
